park.reason: Read the draft release PR: the proposed version and its reason, and the new CHANGELOG.md section. Check the PR title reads `Release X.Y.Z` (edit it if a rework changed the version: open-pr sets the title only when it opens the PR, GR9); the squash commit takes it. Approve to mark the release finished (a person merges the PR; CI then tags and publishes), or reject with the version or changelog changes you want.
